REGULAR MEETING OF THE BOARD OF SUPERVISORS
  ORANGE COUNTY, CALIFORNIA

  Tuesday, April 23, 2024,9 : 0 0 A . M .

  BOARD HEARING ROOM, FIRST FLOOR
  400 W. Civic Center Drive
  Santa Ana, California

  DONALD P. WAGNER
  CHAIRMAN
  Third District

 DOUG CHAFFEE  ANDREW DO
 VICE CHAIRMAN  SUPERVISOR
 Fourth District  First District

 VICENTE SARMIENTO  KATRINA
 SUPERVISOR  FOLEY
 Second District  SUPERVISOR
  Fifth District
ATTENDANCE:All Present

EXCUSED:None

 PRESENT:  COUNTY EXECUTIVE OFFICER  Frank Kim
  COUNTY COUNSEL  Leon J. Page
  CLERK OF THE BOARD  Robin Stieler

INVOCATION:Chairman Wagner, Third District, gave the invocation

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE:Supervisor Do, First District, led the assembly in the Pledge of Allegiance

I.PRESENTATIONS/INTRODUCTIONS

 Vice Chairman Chaffee presented a resolution recognizing April 2024 as "National Arab American
 Heritage Month"

 Supervisor Foley and Supervisor Sarmiento presented a resolution proclaiming April 2024 as
 "Community College Month"

 Supervisor Foley presented a resolution proclaiming April 2024 as "Sexual Assault Awareness Month"

II.CONSENT CALENDAR (Items 1-6)

23145  APPROVED AS RECOMMENDED
 29.  Approve recommended positions on introduced or amended legislation and/or

30.  Approve grant applications/awards submitted by Health Care Agency and Sheriff-

14253  APPROVED AS RECOMMENDED

31.  Approve FY 2023-24 April Budget Update report; approve related budget
  adjustments; direct Auditor-Controller to make payment from Fund 13M to City of
  Orange as summarized; direct County Executive Office, Human Resource Services to
  amend master position control and add one Executive Manager position offset by
  deletion of one Public Health Nurse position for Health Care Agency; direct Auditor-
  Controller to transfer to Approve FY 2023-24 April Budget Update report; approve
  related budget adjustments; direct Auditor-Controller to make payment from Fund
  13M to City of Orange as summarized; direct County Executive Office, Human
  Resource Services to amend master position control and add one Executive Manager
  position offset by deletion of one Public Health Nurse position for Health Care

  CARES, Fund 12M ($5,186,640) from County Local Revenue 2011 Local Innovation

 B.O.  CLOSED PUBLIC HEARING

V.CLOSED SESSION

GENERAL ADMINISTRATION

  County Counsel:
 SCS1.  CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL - EXISTING LITIGATION - Pursuant
  to Government Code Section 54956.9(d)(1):
  Name of Case: Robert McDougal v. County of Orange, USDC Case No. 8:21-cv-
  02027
B.O.  COUNTY COUNSEL READ: THE BOARD UNANIMOUSLY APPROVED A
  PROPOSED $150,000 SETTLEMENT IN THE MATTER OF ROBERT
  MCDOUGAL V. COUNTY OF ORANGE.IN THIS CASE, PLAINTIFF
  CLAIMED VIOLATIONS OF HIS CIVIL RIGHTS AND A FAILURE ON
  THE PART OF THE HCA CORRECTIONAL HEALTH SERVICES TO
  PROVIDE HIM WITH ADEQUATE MEDICAL CARE FOLLOWING AN
  ALTERCATION WITH ANOTHER INMATE IN THE ORANGE COUNTY
  JAIL. THE SETTLEMENT REMAINS SUBJECT TO THE FINAL
  APPROVAL OF OTHERS.WHEN THE SETTLEMENT IS FINALIZED,
  COPIES OF THE SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT CAN BE OBTAINED
  FROM THE OFFICE OF CEO/RISK MANAGEMENT TO ANY PERSON
  WHO INQUIRES.

SCS2.  CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL - EXISTING LITIGATION - Pursuant
  to Government Code Section 54956.9(d)(1):
  Name of Case: Orange County Flood Control District v. McCune Realty Investment
  Co., L.P., Riverside County Superior Court Case No.: CVRI2200225
B.O.  COUNTY COUNSEL READ: THE BOARD UNANIMOUSLY APPROVED A
  PROPOSED $3.5 MILLION SETTLEMENT IN THE MATTER OF ORANGE
  COUNTY FLOOD CONTROL DISTRICT V. MCCUNE REALTY
  INVESTMENT CO. L.P.IN EXCHANGE FOR THE SETTLEMENT
  PAYMENT, THE OCFCD SHALL ACQUIRE A 95,436 SQUARE FOOT
  FLOWAGE EASEMENT OVER REAL PROPERTY IN THE COUNTY OF
  RIVERSIDE.THE FLOWAGE EASEMENT IS NECESSARY FOR THE
  PRADO DAM/SANTA ANA RIVER MAINSTEM FLOOD CONTROL
  PROJECT.AS PART OF THE APPROVAL, THE BOARD AUTHORIZES
  AND DIRECTS COUNTY COUNSEL AND OUTSIDE COUNSEL TO (1) FILE
  AND EXECUTE ALL NECESSARY DOCUMENTS FOR SETTLEMENT OF
  THIS CASE; (2) DIRECT PAYMENT TO THE PROPERTY OWNERS IN
  THE SUM OF $1,451,000, FOR TOTAL JUST COMPENSATION OF
  $3,400,000, PLUS INTEREST AND COSTS OF $100,000.UPON
  COMPLETION AND EXECUTION OF THE SETTLEMENT DOCUMENTS,
  THE BOARD AUTHORIZES AND DIRECTS THE AUDITOR-
  CONTROLLER TO ENCUMBER AND TRANSFER FUNDS TO THE
  PROPERTY OWNER IN THE AMOUNT OF $1,451,000 FROM THE 404
  RESERVE ACCOUNT.FINALLY, THE BOARD AUTHORIZES ALL OTHER
  ACTIONS NECESSARY TO ACCOMPLISH THESE DIRECTIVES BY
  COUNTY COUNSEL AND THE AUDITOR-CONTROLLER. THE
  SETTLEMENT REMAINS SUBJECT TO THE FINAL APPROVAL OF
  OTHERS.WHEN THE SETTLEMENT IS FINALIZED, COPIES OF THE
  SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT CAN BE OBTAINED FROM THE OFFICE
  OF COUNTY COUNSEL TO ANY PERSON WHO INQUIRES.

SCS3.  CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL - EXISTING LITIGATION - Pursuant
  to Government Code Section 54956.9(d)(1):
   Name of Case: Ricardo Martinez v. County of Orange, Orange County Superior
  Court Case No. 30-2021-01208196
B.O.  HELD, NO REPORTABLE ACTION

  IN ADDITION, ON APRIL 9, 2024, THE BOARD MET IN CLOSED SESSION TO DISCUSS THE
  MATTER OF JOHNSON NGUYEN VS. COUNTY OF ORANGE, USDC CASE NO. 8:22CV-01693
  AND THERE WAS NO REPORTABLE ACTION ON THAT DATE. COUNTY COUNSEL
  SUBSEQUENTLY REPORTED AT THE APRIL 23. 2024 BOARD MEETING THAT THE
  PLAINTIFFS ACCEPTED THE COUNTY'S $800,000 COUNTEROFFER TO SETTLE THIS
  CASE, BASED ON A COUNTEROFFER APPROVED IN CLOSED SESSION ON APRIL 9, 2024
  (CHAIRMAN WAGNER AND SUPERVISORS CHAFFEE AND SARMIENTO VOTING AYE,
  AND SUPERVISORS DO AND FOLEY ABSENT). THIS CASE INVOLVES ALLEGATIONS OF
  EXCESSIVE FORCE, WRONGFUL DEATH, AND CIVIL RIGHTS CLAIMS IN CONNECTION
  WITH AN OFFICER INVOLVED SHOOTING AND A STOLEN CAR.
